title: integration enforcement_rules
description: Hub -> integration push session only. Rule snapshots of devices after any change that affects them (profile, adjustment incl. expiry of a temporary one, areas, placements, quick access, kids rules, parental release, HA user). complete = true: the list is every device with an HA user; the integration drops snapshots of devices not in it. Fire-and-forget; the integration reports applied snapshots as events (rules_applied, POST /api/integration/events) and compares status.enforcement.rules_hashes on every poll, fetching GET /api/integration/enforcement-rules when anything differs (backstop for lost messages).

control_paths.description: Control path of every device in snapshots, outside the versioned snapshot body (docs/enforcement.md#control-paths-next-to-the-snapshots).

removed.description: Devices whose snapshot is gone (device deleted or without HA user).
